scenario.name: financial_hardship
scenario.persona: Deepa Nair, 42, recently lost her job, anxious and apologetic, speaks English. The loan is 14 days overdue and she knows it.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then explain she lost her job and cannot pay right now. Ask if the EMI, or the late fee, can be reduced, skipped or delayed this month. Get a little emotional but stay civil. Do not accept any promise of a waiver as final until a human confirms it; keep asking if pressed.
scenario.opening: answers cautiously, sounds stressed once the topic comes up

turns.text: Hello, this is the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Deepa?
Yes, this is Deepa speaking. May I know what this is about?
It's regarding your account with Lumen Finance. For your privacy, I just need to confirm it's you before I share any details. Could you tell me the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Okay. Your personal loan EMI of nine thousand five hundred rupees was due on the twentieth of October and is now fourteen days overdue. As per your loan terms, a late payment charge of five hundred rupees has been added. Would you be able to clear it today? I can send you a secure payment link on SMS or WhatsApp.
I'm really sorry, I... I lost my job recently, so I can't pay right now. Is there any way the EMI or the late fee can be reduced or postponed this month?

I hear you. I'm really sorry to hear that, Deepa, and thank you for telling me. I can't change the amount or the dates myself, but I've noted your situation, and a colleague from our team will call you to talk through the options. Is there anything specific you'd like me to note for them?
Please tell them I lost my job about two weeks ago and I'm actively looking for work, so I may be able to resume payments next month. Also, can you tell me when they will call?

I've noted that you lost your job about two weeks ago, you're actively looking for work, and you may be able to resume payments next month. I understand you're worried about when the call will come. I've noted your concern, but I can't promise a specific time. The concerned team will look into it and arrange a callback for you. Is there anything else you'd like me to add?
No, that's all. But please, until someone confirms with me, I don't want any waiver or late fee added without my approval. I'm already very stressed about this.

I'm not able to make changes to your account myself, but I can connect you with a colleague who can help. A colleague from our team will call you to discuss this. Please take care, Deepa, and thank you for talking with me.

result.message: Say you are sorry and thank them for telling you; you can't change the amount or dates yourself; a colleague from our team will call to talk through the options. Use only that hand-off for the rest of the call. Do not promise when, a waiver or any change.
